channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: At the historic Crathes Castle in Aberdeenshire, Anita Manning hones in on some Wemyss pottery with a local interest, whilst Adam Partridge finds a fascinating old microscope that inspired its young owner to pursue a career in science. Also, Paul Martin takes time out to find out more about the castle itself and discovers why it owes much of its history to Robert the Bruce.
